fixes.explanation: Priest is a fine job, friend, but this verse reaches for a much bigger one. "On that day the LORD will become King over all the earth…" (Zechariah 14:9). All the earth! I can barely keep one bakery counter in order, and that's my whole territory. Then the verse adds "…the LORD alone, and His name alone." (Zechariah 14:9).

A storeroom is a sensible guess, friend, but this verse doesn't send those pots to the back. It says "…the cooking pots in the house of the LORD will be like the sprinkling bowls before the altar." (Zechariah 14:20). Picture my plain old mixing bowl getting a front-row seat beside the fancy serving tray, and everybody treating it with respect. I'd be crying into the dough. That's the jump here: ordinary pots, set right alongside the bowls before the altar.
